call_graph_sample.note: Trace ids are ranked over rows that pass row-level validation; a selected trace whose every (traceid, rpcid) group is rejected at half-collapse contributes no calls, so retained traces can be fewer than requested.

claim_boundary: Calibrated to the complete published v2021 chunk 0 only. No whole-trace, cluster-population, between-chunk or representativeness claim is supported; the call-graph stream is itself an upstream 0.5% sample. Nothing here is face-validity evidence.
corpus_adoption: adopted 2026-08-09 by researcher direction, per calibration_corpus_memo.md recommendation (docs/decision_prep_20260728/calibration_corpus_memo.md)

root_service_selection.note: Roots are identified in the call-graph member, which is an upstream 0.5% sample, so a root may report no row of the selected metric family in the metric member. Those roots are excluded from the aggregate and the sealed shape lists exactly the roots that contributed.
